tg_harbourclerk: I book berths. I do not judge them. That is the whole job and it is a good job.
Eleven to twenty went in one transaction, in spring, for a year.
I have never once written a receipt that large and I have never once slept worse.
tg_pilotmaster: Every boat over forty feet takes a pilot in. That is law and it is my law.
The charter berths take their own. They brought their own from somewhere.
They know my channel better than my pilots do. Work out how, and tell me.
